decision_gate.reason: The asymmetric match formulation systematically allows strict triad subsets to tie complete seventh templates, while diminished candidates are absent entirely.

diminished_forensics.mechanism: No diminished candidate template exists, so diminished failure is separate from seventh subset ties.

dominant_seventh.primary_mechanism: Asymmetric template coverage gives a complete triad subset and its seventh extension the same pitch-match score. With no extra-tone penalty, stable template insertion order selects the earlier triad on ties; sparse E-major priors make the triad strictly higher for E7, A7, and B7.

limitations: Candidate scores and margins are diagnostics, not calibrated confidence.
Only existing score terms are ablated; no replacement score or production repair is evaluated.
Matching context is limited to positive priors available in the scorer's E-major and A-major tables.
No audio, transcription, segmentation, temporal decoding, retrieval, or tutor logic is exercised.

terms.bass_bonus: +0.25 when bass is template root, +0.10 when another template tone, otherwise 0
terms.complexity_penalty: -0.10 for 7/min7/maj7 candidates only when input has at most three pitch classes
terms.key_prior: lookup by (candidate root, quality); sparse E-major/A-major table; larger is better
terms.pitch_match: |input pitch classes intersect template| / |template pitch classes|; range 0..1; larger is better
terms.suspension_adjustment: +0.10 for proper sus2/sus4, +0.15 for Bsus4_priority, otherwise -0.20

scoring_equation.tie_break: Python stable descending score sort preserves template insertion order; major templates precede seventh templates for each root

template_inventory.tone_weighting: All template tones are equally weighted through set intersection.

nonexistent_terms.extra_tone_penalty: absent; unexplained input tones do not affect score
nonexistent_terms.missing_tone_penalty: absent; missing tones reduce pitch_match only through template coverage
